title: Double Date
cn: 第 2 集 · 双人约会
novel:
Ted had a new girlfriend, and somehow she looked almost exactly like Robin. "It's a [[coincidence|coincidence]]," Ted [[insisted|insist]], though no one believed him.

Barney [[arranged|arrange]] a double date so the gang could compare the two women side by side. The [[resemblance|resemblance]] was impossible to ignore. They laughed the same way. They even [[ordered|order]] the same drink.

Robin grew [[uneasy|uneasy]]. "Are you dating her because she looks like me?" she asked.

Ted [[stammered|stammer]]. He could not [[deny|deny]] that the [[similarity|similarity]] had drawn him in.

Barney found the whole thing [[hilarious|hilarious]]. "You're [[obsessed|obsess]]!" he laughed.

Lily, more [[sensitive|sensitive]] to feelings, pulled Ted aside. "You have to [[let go of|let go of]] Robin. Dating her [[clone|clone]] isn't fair to anyone."

Ted knew she was right. That night he broke up with the girlfriend, feeling both [[guilty|guilty]] and [[relieved|relieved]]. Some [[comparisons|comparison]], he decided, only proved how hard it was to [[move on|move on]].

coincidence.en: when two things happen at the same time by chance

insist.en: to say firmly that something is true

arrange.en: to plan or organize something in advance

resemblance.en: the fact of looking like someone or something

order.en: to ask for food or drink in a restaurant

stammer.en: to speak with many pauses and repeated sounds

deny.en: to say that something is not true

similarity.en: the fact of being like someone or something

obsess.en: to think about someone or something all the time

sensitive.en: easily hurt or upset by what people say

let go of.en: to stop holding or caring about something

clone.en: someone who looks exactly like another person

guilty.en: feeling bad because you did something wrong

relieved.en: happy that something unpleasant has ended

comparison.en: the act of looking at two things to see how they are alike

move on.en: to start doing something new after finishing something else
